create_kmeans_clustering: create a KMeans clustering model and fit it on data to discover cluster centers and assign labels
run_kmeans_clustering: run k_means function to perform K-means clustering on data and return centroids, labels, and inertia
initialize_centroids_kmeans: initialize cluster centroids using kmeans_plusplus algorithm for smart centroid seeding
create_minibatch_kmeans: create a MiniBatchKMeans model for incremental clustering on large datasets using mini-batches
predict_cluster_labels: predict the closest cluster label for new samples using a fitted KMeans or MiniBatchKMeans model
